headerDisplay: Exposes a Finnmark FD-5 sauna to HomeKit via a local [saunad](https://github.com/jstonebender/ios-sauna-controller) bridge. saunad must be reachable from this Homebridge host.
footerDisplay: ⚠️ This exposes a **heating appliance** to HomeKit automations. Strongly consider setting `server.heaterMaxOnMinutes` in saunad's options.json as a deadman cutoff.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: saunad server.apiKey (Bearer token for /control). Leave blank only if saunad auth is disabled.

exposeRainbowSwitch.title: Expose Rainbow switch
exposeRainbowSwitch.description: A linked switch for the lights' Scroll (color-cycle) effect.
